name: Lenumius

attributes.attribute: a Celtic god of war and the field
drawn to the Roman god Mars

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Lenumius was a Continental Celtic god. The Romans equated him with Mars, who governed war and the fields. We know his name from a few inscriptions, and from these we have little else about him.

key_results: He was a Continental Celtic god.
The Romans equated him with Mars.
His name survives on a few inscriptions.
He ruled both war and the cultivation of the land.
